headline: Common Mistakes When Redesigning Your Kitchen Layout
articleBody: Redesigning your kitchen layout is a big step, and it’s easy to stumble into common pitfalls. One major mistake is ignoring the 'work triangle' – that efficient path between your sink, stove, and refrigerator. If you don't plan this properly, you'll find yourself running marathons just to make dinner! Another common error is underestimating storage needs. People often focus only on aesthetics and forget about where everything will actually go. Don't forget about proper ventilation, either; a powerful range hood is essential, especially in an open layout. Sometimes, folks try to DIY structural changes without consulting pros, which can lead to serious safety issues and code violations. Finally, not setting a realistic budget from the start can derail the whole project. You need to account for everything from demolition to finishes, and always have a contingency fund.
